draft_memo.title: SwiftCart Delivery Growth and Costs Analysis
draft_memo.body:
SwiftCart completed 1 million deliveries in 2025, which is an increase from 800,000 deliveries in 2024 [P05]. The on-time delivery rate improved from 90% in 2024 to 92% in 2025 [P05]. SwiftCart's average cost per delivery rose from 5.00 credits in 2024 to 5.40 credits in 2025 [P06]. Higher fuel and labour costs were cited in its fictional annual report [P06]. The increase in delivery volume from 800,000 to 1 million deliveries represents a growth of 200,000 deliveries year-over-year [P05]. The rise in the on-time delivery rate from 90% to 92% shows an increase of 2 percentage points [P05]. The average cost per delivery increased by 0.40 credits from 5.00 credits to 5.40 credits [P06]. The report does not provide specific figures on how many deliveries were late or the reasons for delays [P05]. The source does not clarify the overall impact of higher fuel and labour costs on SwiftCart's operations [P06].

Interpretation: SwiftCart experienced an increase in delivery volume and reliability alongside a rise in delivery costs.

Limitations: The source does not provide details on the specific reasons for the increase in delivery costs. There is no information on customer satisfaction or feedback regarding the delivery service. The data does not include comparisons to industry benchmarks or competitors. There is no breakdown of costs associated with different delivery types or regions. The report does not specify the impact of external economic factors on SwiftCart's operations. The source does not clarify how the improvements in delivery rates were achieved.
footnotes: [P06] SwiftCart annual report: cost per delivery, 2025.
